g.text: Allow employee payroll deduction for overages
Catalog automatically pruned to 42 matching SKUs
Auto-route to Secondary DC if inventory < 5 units
Require Plant Mgr sign-off if cart total > $225.00
Dept: Stamping Line B // Annual Allowance: $150.00 (Unused)
Rule #3 requires an active departmental PO code before an employee
order can be routed to DC-04 Chicago warehouse.
Facility LOC-88204 inherits enterprise parent rules by default. Toggling 'Inherit' off unlocks facility overrides with auditor logging.
Prevents gaming year-end resets. Employee allowance tracks purchase date timestamp rather than calendar Jan 1.
Safety compliance locks catalog view. Uncertified items (e.g., standard composite toes) are strictly hidden from employee selection.
If shoe price ($189.99) exceeds subsidy cap ($150.00), the delta ($39.99) is automatically split and routed to employer payroll deduction API.
Checkout CTA is locked in error state until an authorized Honda PO code is verified against Grainger ERP billing service.
Orders exceeding $225 trigger an asynchronous approval hold sent to Plant Manager inbox before warehouse pick ticket is generated.
Employee orders 2nd pair within 12 mo: system displays allowance depleted banner with self-pay opt-in.
Legacy footwear channel synced with new industrial supply catalog with zero duplicate account IDs.
Seamless failover routing to DC-09 (Dallas) with automatic ETA recalculation shown during cart review.
Temporary worker accounts require pre-funded department allocation code with expiry date check.
Validated with Grainger Product Mgr & Engineering leads
